title: Satisfying assignments and free coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $T$ be a term of literals on $n$ coordinates. There is an equivalence between sign vectors satisfying $T$ and assignments of signs to the coordinates outside the support of $T$: it sends a satisfying vector to its restriction there, and its inverse fills coordinates in the support with their required signs.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a term of literals on $n$ coordinates
